# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 94 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 50 | Coptic

---

## Saying 94

Jesus said: "One who seeks will find, and to one who knocks it will be opened."

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "One who seeks" — gender-neutral universal
- The passive "will be opened" — the divine opening without specifying the opener
- Condensed to match Thomas's two-part form
